newsitem.title: USA: Blockbuster building N. American distribution site.
newsitem.headline: Blockbuster building N. American distribution site.

text.p: Blockbuster Entertainment, a unit of Viacom Inc, said Wednesday it began building its North American distribution center in McKinney, Texas, 25 miles northeast of Dallas.
The center's construction is part of the company's plans, which includes opening up to 600 new U.S. stores in 1997, the company said.

The center is expected to open in the fall and employ about 800 people, Blockbuster said. The facility will centralize distribution of video, music and other entertainment products to its more than 4,000 stores in the U.S. and Canada, it said.
Blockbuster, which has more than 5,000 stores around the world, is scheduled to move its headquarters to Dallas in the spring.
